equations: Empirical thrust estimate = fitted intercept + fitted slope × standardized input power.
Candidate thrust is screened against the estimate minus one internal cross-validation RMSE.
limitations: A gated data-derived relationship is used only as an empirical screening constraint; it is not treated as a physical law or causal relation.

Cross-validation reuses one dataset and its RMSE is not a statistical confidence bound; independent validation and hardware testing remain necessary.
